### How can I help?

I've worked through lots of data-related problems in my career and these cover a wide variety of domains.
What I can do for you fits into three different types of support: leadership, review and hands-on.

The kinds data problems I've worked with include GIS/spatial, surveys, engineering pipelines, training, recruitment, and more.
Have a look at my [blog](blog.qmd) for examples.

[{{< fa envelope >}} Please get in touch](mailto:consult@mikerspencer.com), especially if you have a data problem that doesn't neatly fit into one of these!
I love figuring out solutions.


## Support 

I offer three types of support:

- [Leadership](services.qmd#leadership)
- [Review](services.qmd#review)
- [Hands-on](services.qmd#hands-on)

There's overlap between these levels, so don't feel constrained.
I'm happy to work on short comissions or longer term engagements.

### Leading

- Recruitment: specification, adverts, CV sifting & interviews
- Mentoring and team development
- Training and skills
- Defining project requirements
- Detailing *good-enough* to minimise effort and cost

This kind of support can work well in concentrated sprints or short periods of time spread across multiple weeks.


### Reviewing

- Quality assurance (eg testing, replication and detailing improvements)
- Review processes and code
- Recommend ways to optimise for reduced run-times and lower costs
- Workflows, pipelines and reproducibility


### Hands-on

- Additional capacity
- Methods appraisal
- Outsourced projects
- Outsourced data dept
- Workflows, pipelines and reproducibility
- Data preparation
- Research and analysis
